title: ICR Project Tag
description: Provenance tags applied as meta.tag on the instances that ship with this IG (worked examples and demo datasets), so they can be filtered or excluded in one search (?_tag=). This is NOT a normative vocabulary: implementers tag their own datasets with their own code system (tags are not bound to any value set); the codes here exist only so the IG's own instances validate cleanly.

concept.definition: The ESPEN MDA demo instrument set and its scenario examples.
The worked Sierra Leone measles-rubella SIA scenario (working doc §11): protocol, umbrella + round campaigns, site-session/mop-up/follow-up tasks, dose, AEFIs, and the admin-vs-survey coverage pair.
The community-directed albendazole MDA thread: drug supply, community task, register entry, stratified treatment tally, geographic coverage, and supervision.
Standalone activity-gallery pieces demonstrating other campaign types (ITN distribution, IRS).
The five-state northern Nigeria demo campaign calendar (Bauchi, Kano, Jigawa, Gombe, Yobe; 2022–2027) generated by tools/campaign-builder — CarePlans, protocols and planning denominators only.

The Toro LGA (Bauchi) polio NIPDs microplanning + monitoring snapshot generated by tools/microplan-builder: one facility-level ICRCampaign per health-facility catchment under an LGA round, a care team per facility, under-5 denominators per settlement catchment, and one house-to-house ICRCampaignTask per settlement with tally outputs as of a snapshot date.
